0022600015.text: The Hornets (3-2, on a one-game losing streak) visit the Washington Wizards (2-3, on a two-game losing streak) in this Emirates NBA Cup East Group C matchup, with Charlotte 1st in the Southeast and 6th in the East and Washington 3rd in the Southeast, one game back, and 9th in the East. Charlotte is missing Coby White, Grant Williams, Kon Knueppel and Kylan Boswell, while Washington is without Jamir Watkins, Justin Champagnie, Tre Johnson and Tristan Vukcevic. The Hornets lead the 2026-27 season series 1-0 after a 110-103 win in Charlotte on October 26, and they also won all four meetings in 2025-26.
